correctness.rationale: The explicit binomial(n,2) polynomial family equals the Jacobian ideal by the characteristic-two recursive identities. Same-level and adjacent-level Buchberger reductions plus the chain criterion establish the universal initial ideal. Its standard-monomial recurrence and n=4 base case yield every Hilbert coefficient. Zero-coordinate cases and the generic normal quadratic ab+ac+bc establish support and local length two. Exact finite checks corroborate but are not the all-n proof.
